text:
Handmade with care, this ceramic mug is made to be part of your daily routine. Whether it holds your morning coffee, an afternoon tea, or a late-night cocoa, its handcrafted character makes every sip feel a little more personal. Because each piece is made by hand, small variations are part of its charm, so no two are exactly alike.

Care is simple: this mug is dishwasher safe, but please do not use it in the microwave. Hand-wash or run it through the dishwasher, and reheat your drink another way. It also makes a thoughtful gift for anyone who appreciates something made by hand.
